title: Optimizing meshoptimizer to process billions of triangles in minutes (2025)
summary: A technical deep-dive by Arseny Kapoulkine on optimizing the meshoptimizer library to achieve dramatic performance improvements, enabling processing of billions of triangles in minutes through low-level optimizations and algorithmic improvements.
problem_solved: Achieving massive performance improvements for 3D mesh optimization when processing very large models with billions of triangles
why_valuable: Enables real-time processing of massive 3D datasets, which is critical for game engines, VR/AR applications, CAD systems, and scientific visualization at scale
